declarations.description:
A one-line query field in the `key:value` syntax of Datadog, GitHub and Sentry: `service:web -status:>=500 "timed out"`.
The query is coloured as it is typed (keys, values, comparators, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, negations, free text), and the
fields listed in `fields` are offered as the caret moves: their keys while a word is typed, and their `values` right
after `key:`. Arrow keys move through the suggestions, **Enter** or **Tab** inserts one, and **Enter** with none
active runs the query: `search` fires with the query and its parsed `terms`. **Escape** closes the suggestions, then
clears the field.

`fields` is JSON as an attribute (`[{"key":"service","values":["web","api"]}]`) or an array as a property. With
`fields` set, a key that is not one of them is underlined as unknown, as is an unterminated quote, and the host
matches `:state(invalid)`. Values that must be fetched can follow the `suggest` event, which reports the key and
prefix the caret is completing whenever they change: update that field's `values` in response.

The syntax helpers behind it, `tokenizeQuery` and `parseQuery`, are exported for use on the server. `input` and
`change` are re-dispatched from the inner input, and the element is form-associated (`name`). The host exposes
`:state(focus-within)`, `:state(expanded)`, `:state(invalid)` and `:state(disabled)`.

The highlighting is drawn under a transparent input, so the colour variables may change colours, backgrounds and
decorations only: anything that changes the width of a character (font weight, padding) would misalign the caret.

cssProperties.description: Space between the icons and the query.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input--gap

cssProperties.description: Colour of free text and of the caret.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input--color

cssProperties.description: Font of the field and the suggestions; a monospace font suits long queries.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input--font-family

cssProperties.description: The field name before the colon.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__key--color

cssProperties.description: The colon between key and value.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__separator--color

cssProperties.description: Free text and quoted phrases; inherits the field colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__text--color

cssProperties.description: The `-` or `!` that negates a term.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__negation--color

cssProperties.description: Wavy underline of an unknown key or an unterminated quote.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__invalid--color

cssProperties.description: Gap between the field and the suggestions.
cssProperties.name: --c2-query-input__panel--offset

slots.description: Replaces the magnifier at the start of the field.
slots.name: search-icon

slots.description: Replaces the cross of the clear button.
slots.name: clear-icon

slots.description: Icon or control at the end of the field, after the clear button (a help link, a run button).
slots.name: suffix-icon

members.name: value
members.description: The query. Setting the attribute after the user has typed no longer updates it, like a native input.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the field. Defaults to the placeholder, then to "Search query".

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the query is submitted with the form under this name.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the field and its suggestions.

members.name: fields
members.description: The fields the query can filter on, offered as keys and, after `key:`, their values. JSON as an attribute.

members.name: fieldsLabel
members.description: Heading of the suggestions while a key is typed.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: terms
members.description: The terms of the current query.

members.name: clear
members.description: Empties the field as the clear button does: fires `clear`, `input`, `change` and `search`.

members.name: isInvalid
members.description: Whether a token is marked invalid: an unknown key while `fields` is set, or an unterminated quote.

members.name: completionAt
members.description: What the caret is completing, or `undefined` where nothing is suggested (inside a quoted phrase, on an operator).

members.name: emitSuggest
members.description: Fires `suggest` when the key or value the caret is completing changed.

members.name: syncScroll
members.description: Keeps the highlight layer scrolled with the input when the query is wider than the field.

events.name: clear
events.description: Fired when the clear button or Escape emptied the field, before `input`, `change` and `search`.

events.name: input
events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input on every keystroke; also fired when a suggestion or the clear button changes the value.

events.name: change
events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input when the value is committed; also fired when a suggestion or the clear button changes the value.

events.name: search
events.description: The query to run, with its parsed `terms`: on Enter, and with an empty value when cleared. Does not bubble; listen on the element.

events.name: suggest
events.description: The key or value the caret is completing changed: `kind`, `key` and `prefix`. Update `fields` in response to suggest values fetched on demand. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: value

attributes.name: placeholder
